verify.notes: Official reference is the formula1.com map of the same GP layout (2020 Eifel GP); the layout is unchanged since 2002 and GTWC lists the same 17-turn, 5.137 km circuit. The SRO event-page site plan (images/circuits/track_27.jpg) is a venue map, not to scale enough to extract. Corner-number badges leave short spurs in the extraction. Rallycross ways excluded from the OSM graph.

notes: Lap = closed loop of the raceway ways closest to the official length.
